name: CapCut - Video Editor
summary: The CapCut APK is the official Android app for CapCut, Bytedance's free video editor with templates, auto captions, effects and AI tools. The latest version is 20.3.0, updated November 23, 2026, and needs Android 6.0 or newer. It's free to use, with CapCut Pro for premium features.
metaDescription: CapCut APK download for Android: get the official CapCut 20.3.0 from Google Play, with install steps, editing tips, export fixes and CapCut Pro explained.

faq.a: Yes. CapCut is free to download and edit with. CapCut Pro, an optional subscription, unlocks premium effects, filters, AI tools and cloud storage.

faq.q: Why won't CapCut let me export?
faq.a: Usually your project contains a Pro feature, such as a premium effect or template, while you're on the free plan. Remove the Pro items marked in the timeline, or subscribe, then export again.

The official CapCut app from Google Play, published by Bytedance Pte. Ltd., is safe to install. Review its privacy settings, and avoid unofficial CapCut copies offering free Pro, which can carry malware.

faq.q: Can I use CapCut on my laptop?
faq.a: Yes. CapCut has desktop apps for Windows and Mac and an online editor, and projects can sync through CapCut cloud storage.
